conservation_status.note_en: No species-level global IUCN assessment was found; Not Evaluated is not a measure of abundance or safety.
conservation_status.note_zh: 未找到该物种的全球IUCN物种级评估；未评估不代表数量多或安全。

description.en: A beautiful blue sea slug that floats upside down on the ocean surface and eats venomous jellyfish.
description.zh: 一种美丽的蓝色海蛞蝓，肚皮朝上漂浮在海面上，以有毒的水母为食。

anatomy.en: They are only 3 cm long. They use countershading: their blue belly faces up to match the water, and their silver back faces down.
anatomy.zh: 它们只有 3 厘米长。它们利用反荫蔽：蓝色的腹部朝上以融入海水，银色的背部朝下。

ecology_and_behavior.en: They float by swallowing air bubbles. They swallow the stinging cells of jellyfish and use them for their own defense.
ecology_and_behavior.zh: 它们通过吞食气泡来漂浮。它们会吞下水母的刺细胞，并将其转用于自身的防御。

habitat_and_distribution.en: Found in temperate and tropical waters of the Atlantic, Pacific, and Indian Oceans.
habitat_and_distribution.zh: 分布于大西洋、太平洋和印度洋的温带及热带海域。

range_review.comparison_en: The previous center and zoom are retained exactly. The point is a representative location, not the full range; no reusable authoritative polygon was established in this review.
range_review.comparison_zh: 原有中心点和缩放级别完全保留。该点是代表性位置而非完整分布范围；本次复核未取得可复用的权威多边形。

content_review.notes: Taxonomy, current global status, legacy bilingual sections, image identity criteria and unchanged habitat geometry reviewed for legacy QC batch 03B–03E.

life_cycle_and_reproduction.en: Reproduction produces eggs and dispersing larval stages before juveniles take on the adult body plan. Development and survival depend strongly on water conditions and prey availability.
life_cycle_and_reproduction.zh: 繁殖产生卵和可扩散的幼体阶段，随后幼体形成成体体制。发育与存活强烈依赖水体条件和猎物供应。

detail.en: They are only 3 cm long. They use countershading: their blue belly faces up to match the water, and their silver back faces down.
detail.zh: 它们只有 3 厘米长。它们利用反荫蔽：蓝色的腹部朝上以融入海水，银色的背部朝下。

detail.en: They float by swallowing air bubbles. They swallow the stinging cells of jellyfish and use them for their own defense.
detail.zh: 它们通过吞食气泡来漂浮。它们会吞下水母的刺细胞，并将其转用于自身的防御。

detail.en: Found in temperate and tropical waters of the Atlantic, Pacific, and Indian Oceans.
detail.zh: 分布于大西洋、太平洋和印度洋的温带及热带海域。

ecological_role.en: As a carnivore in ocean habitat, this species transfers energy through its food web; the detailed effects depend on local abundance, prey or food plants, and interactions described by the cited ecology source.
ecological_role.zh: 作为海洋生境中的肉食性，该物种在食物网中传递能量；具体影响取决于当地数量、猎物或食物植物，以及所引生态来源描述的相互作用。

threats.en: A missing global assessment creates uncertainty; it must not be converted into a claim that the species is secure.
threats.zh: 缺少全球评估意味着存在不确定性；不能据此宣称该物种安全。

actions.en: Protect the habitats and ecological processes identified by range authorities, reduce documented direct mortality, and update management when population monitoring or taxonomy changes.
actions.zh: 应保护分布权威所确认的生境和生态过程，减少有记录的直接死亡，并在种群监测或分类变化时更新管理。

key_features.en: They are only 3 cm long. They use countershading: their blue belly faces up to match the water, and their silver back faces down.
key_features.zh: 它们只有 3 厘米长。它们利用反荫蔽：蓝色的腹部朝上以融入海水，银色的背部朝下。

similar_species.en: Close relatives and regional look-alikes may share color or body shape. Confirm records with multiple visible characters, location and an exact taxon-linked source rather than a filename or single feature.
similar_species.zh: 近缘种和地区性相似种可能共享颜色或体形。记录应结合多个可见特征、地点和精确分类单元来源确认，不能只凭文件名或单一特征。

communication_and_senses.en: The species uses the sensory channels available to its class—vision, sound, chemical cues, touch or vibration—in combinations shaped by its habitat. The cited species account should be used before assigning a specific call or signal.
communication_and_senses.zh: 该物种会组合使用其类群具备的视觉、声音、化学信号、触觉或振动等感官通道，具体组合受生境塑造。指定某种叫声或信号前，应查阅所引物种资料。

seasonal_calendar.en: Breeding, movement, molt, dormancy or food use can shift with latitude, rainfall, temperature and resource pulses. A date from one population must not be presented as universal.
seasonal_calendar.zh: 繁殖、迁移、换羽、休眠或食物利用会随纬度、降雨、温度和资源脉冲变化。不能把某一种群的日期写成全球统一规律。

relationship_with_humans.en: Use, conflict, tourism and cultural relationships vary across the range. Safe observation avoids handling, feeding, playback, nest or den disturbance, and any approach that changes natural behavior.
relationship_with_humans.zh: 利用、冲突、旅游和文化关系因分布区而异。安全观察应避免触摸、投喂、播放叫声、干扰巢穴或洞穴，以及任何改变自然行为的接近。

evolution.en: Glaucus atlanticus is placed in Glaucus, family Glaucidae, order Nudibranchia. This review follows the accepted species match cited in the taxonomy source.
evolution.zh: Glaucus atlanticus归入海神鳃属、海神鳃科、裸鳃目。本次复核遵循分类来源所引的接受种匹配。

field_signs.en: Tracks, calls, nests, feeding marks, molts or other indirect signs may narrow an identification but usually cannot confirm a species alone. Fresh sign near a dangerous or sensitive animal requires distance.
field_signs.zh: 足迹、叫声、巢、取食痕迹、蜕皮或其他间接线索可缩小鉴定范围，但通常不能单独确认物种。危险或敏感动物附近的新鲜痕迹意味着应保持距离。

text.en: Its accepted scientific name in this review is Glaucus atlanticus.
text.zh: 本次复核采用的接受学名是Glaucus atlanticus。

text.en: Not Evaluated means a global species assessment was not available, not that extinction risk is zero.
text.zh: 未评估表示缺少全球物种评估，不代表灭绝风险为零。

text.en: The map retains a representative point and explicitly does not present it as the full range.
text.zh: 地图保留代表点，并明确不把它当作完整分布范围。

content.en: Reproduction produces eggs and dispersing larval stages before juveniles take on the adult body plan. Development and survival depend strongly on water conditions and prey availability.
content.zh: 繁殖产生卵和可扩散的幼体阶段，随后幼体形成成体体制。发育与存活强烈依赖水体条件和猎物供应。
